title: Restore course portal access
body: Use the Forgot password link on the course portal sign-in page to reset your password. The reset link is sent to your registered university email and expires after 30 minutes. If your account is locked or the link fails, submit a support request with your student or staff reference and the error message. Never include your password in a ticket.

title: Official letters and transcripts
body: Request an enrollment letter or official transcript from Student Services. Include your student reference, the document type, and the receiving organization. The records team checks enrollment before preparing the document. Document collection instructions are sent to your university email.

title: Connect to the campus wireless network
body: Choose the Campus network and sign in with your university account. Remove a saved connection if your device still uses an old password. For persistent Wi-Fi or laptop connection failures, provide the building, device type, and time of the problem to IT Support.

title: Library loans and renewals
body: Renew a library loan in the library catalog before its due date. An item reserved by another borrower cannot be renewed. Visit the library service desk for a lost book, an incorrect overdue charge, or an account issue.

title: Report a room or building fault
body: Report facilities issues with the building name, room number, and a description of the fault. Include whether the room can still be used. Room access cards and classroom equipment faults are handled by the Facilities service desk.

title: Tuition invoice questions
body: Download a tuition invoice from your student finance account. For an incorrect fee or missing payment, provide the invoice reference and payment date to Student Finance. Do not put bank card numbers or bank account credentials in a request.

title: Semester enrollment deadlines
body: The autumn enrollment window closes on October 25. Review your course selections with your academic adviser before confirming enrollment. For a missed deadline or a course enrollment correction, submit a request to Student Services with the affected course code.

title: Staff annual leave approval
body: Submit an annual leave request to Staff Administration with the start date, end date, leave type, and manager name. The manager must approve the dates before the leave is recorded. Check your leave balance in the staff self-service system before submitting.

title: Staff payroll and payslip corrections
body: Request a payroll correction from Staff Administration and specify the payslip month and the item that appears incorrect. The payroll officer checks the recorded employment details and responds through the staff service inbox. Attachments must exclude bank credentials.
